Your part in an IR35 determination

A short guide for Ørsted line managers. You do one piece of this: describe how the consultant will actually work, run the determination, and pass the statement to YunoJuno once it is issued.

What you are responsible for

  • Describing the engagement accurately. You know how the work is really done. Everything downstream rests on that.
  • You do not issue the statement. You run the determination; the SDS is issued by the Client Administrator, or by the IR35 Escalation Reviewer if the case is borderline.
  • You put the issued SDS into YunoJuno. That is the last step, and it is yours.

1Signing in

There is no password and no authenticator app. You sign in with a six-digit code emailed to you, every time.

  1. Go to https://ir35workbench.co.uk/orsted/
  2. Type your work email address and click Email me a sign-in code.
  3. A six-digit code arrives within a minute or so, from IR35 Workbench Team (assessments@ir35workbench.co.uk). If it is not in your inbox, check your junk or quarantine folder.
  4. Type the code into the box and click Sign in.
  • Each code works once. If you need another, click Send me a new code — the previous one stops working.
  • Only addresses Ørsted has set up will work. There is no self sign-up.
  • Ignore Sign in with Google and Sign in with Apple — those are for consultants.
  • You land on the Role Library, which is where an assessment starts. You only ever see your own consultants.

2Assessing a consultant

  1. In the Role Library, find the role and click Pre-fill a worker →. The role must already be in the library — if it is not there, ask your Client Administrator to add it before you start.
  2. New Assessment opens with that role selected. Enter the consultant’s name and email address. The email address is how they are invited, so get it right.
  3. Answer the first four questions at the top. They are about this particular engagement: whether the contract has already started, whether this consultant has worked for Ørsted before, whether they hold a statutory office such as a directorship or board seat, and whether they are personally named in the contract. Nobody else can answer these for you.
  4. Work down the rest of the questions. They are already filled in from the role library. Read each one against this consultant and change anything that differs — a divergence from the library is recorded, which is the point.
  5. Wherever there is a notes box, add a sentence of evidence: what the contract says, what actually happens on site. This is what demonstrates reasonable care if the determination is ever questioned.
  6. Complete the engagement details: how the consultant is engaged (direct, through an agency, or through Ascend payroll), the agency’s contact email if there is one, and the assignment start date. The statement has to reach everyone in the payment chain, so these are required.
  7. Click Run determination.

3What happens next

  • The consultant is saved to the Worker Register as Awaiting consultant, and an invitation is emailed to them automatically. No determination has been made and no statement has been issued yet.
  • They answer their own questionnaire. Nothing can move until they do — if they are slow, chase them.
  • Their answers merge with yours and the determination runs. A clear case goes to the Client Administrator to sign off. A borderline case goes to the IR35 Escalation Reviewer first.
  • You can follow all of this in the Worker Register.

4When the SDS arrives — put it into YunoJuno

  1. Once the statement is issued you receive it by email as a PDF, and it is also on the consultant’s record in the Workbench.
  2. Enter it into YunoJuno against the assignment. The Workbench does not do this for you, and the determination is not operationally complete until it is done.
  3. Do it promptly. Until the statement is in YunoJuno, the assignment is being run without a recorded status.

5A few things worth knowing

  • Re-assess on any material change to the role, the rate or the way the work is done. Open the consultant in the Worker Register and update the answers; they are re-merged and re-audited.
  • If the consultant disagrees with their determination they may make representations to Ørsted, who must respond within 45 days. Pass anything like that to your Client Administrator.
  • Every action is recorded against your name. Please don’t share a sign-in code or assess on someone else’s behalf.
